// diagnostic

E1412

Devtools publication names unknown state field `{field}`

What

Devtools publication names unknown state field `{field}`

Why

Package `{package}` module `{module_name}` has no marked panel `{panel}` field with that name

Fix

Write `field: .{field}` using a field from the package's marked `panel` state

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1412: tests/ui/e1412_devtools_publish_unknown_field.stderr.

Error [jet.UnknownDevtoolsField]: Devtools panel `publish` is invalid
  --> tests/ui/e1412_devtools_publish_unknown_field.jet:17:22
    |
 17 |     devtools.publish(field: .chosen, value: "overview")
    |                      ^^^^^
 Why: The package has no uniquely identified panel field `chosen`
 Fix: Publish a field declared by the package's marked `panel` state
